<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

Decoded logprob tokens can contain U+FFFD even though the generated text is valid. With Qwen3, the logprob tokens of `🍰이 맛있다` join to `��이 맛�다`. This fixes the correction in `LogprobsProcessor` for tokens that start with the rest of a split UTF-8 character and then contain more text, and the copy of that correction in `OnlineDerenderer`, which the `/derender` endpoints use.

## Claims

- Sample logprobs (streaming and non-streaming) and prompt logprobs of such tokens now decode to the right text in `/v1/completions`, `/v1/chat/completions` (including `top_logprobs`), `/inference/v1/generate` with `output_mode="text"`, and `/v1/chat/completions/derender` and `/v1/completions/derender`: for Qwen3 and `🍰이 맛있다`, the logprob tokens join to the same string as the output text.
- Tokens whose decoded text ends with U+FFFD are corrected as before.

## Validation

Unit tests (CPU, Python-only install):

```bash
python -m pytest tests/v1/engine/test_logprobs_processor.py -q
# main: 4 failed, 3 passed. This PR: 7 passed.
python -m pytest tests/entrypoints/scale_out/derender/test_generate_logprobs_conversion.py -q
# main: 4 failed, 5 passed. This PR: 9 passed.
python -m pytest tests/v1/sample/test_logprobs.py -q -k TestCorrectDecodedToken
# 11 passed, 53 deselected (existing UTF-8 correction tests)
```

The new `test_utf8_continuation_before_valid_suffix` in `test_logprobs_processor.py` feeds the Qwen3 token IDs of `🍰이 맛있다` through `LogprobsProcessor` as sample and prompt logprobs, with both logprob storage formats, and also with the emoji's first bytes split over two byte tokens. It checks that the decoded logprob tokens join to the decoded text. The test of the same name in `test_generate_logprobs_conversion.py` does the same for `OnlineDerenderer._resolve_logprobs`, for whole responses and one-token chunks, and also checks the top-candidate strings and the `bytes`.

End to end on an L4 with `vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B --enforce-eager`, comparing the wheel for fa75d3456 (`main`) with the same wheel plus this change. `/v1/completions` with `logprobs: 0`, once with `echo: true, max_tokens: 0` on the prompt `Caption: 🍰이 맛있다`, and twice (non-streaming and streaming) generating `🍰이 맛있다` with `structured_outputs: {"regex": ...}`:

| Request | Logprob tokens on `main` | Logprob tokens with this PR |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Prompt logprobs (`echo`) | `Caption`, `:`, ``, ` 🍰`, `이`, ``, ` 맛`, ``, `�다` | `Caption`, `:`, ``, ` 🍰`, `이`, ``, ` 맛`, ``, `있다` |
| Generation, non-streaming | ``, ``, ``, `🍰`, `이`, ` `, ``, `맛`, ``, `�다`, `<\|im_end\|>` | ``, ``, ``, `🍰`, `이`, ` `, ``, `맛`, ``, `있다`, `<\|im_end\|>` |
| Generation, streaming | same as non-streaming | same as non-streaming |

The generated text is `🍰이 맛있다` in both runs; only the decoded logprob tokens differ.

A second run with `--enable-scale-out` sent `/v1/chat/completions` (`logprobs: true, top_logprobs: 3`), `/inference/v1/generate` with `output_mode: "text"`, and the token output of `/inference/v1/generate` through `/v1/chat/completions/derender` and `/v1/completions/derender`, each streaming and non-streaming (8 requests). The logprob tokens matched the generated text in 0 of 8 on `main` and in 8 of 8 with this PR. With only the `LogprobsProcessor` change, the two derender endpoints still returned `�다`.

`pre-commit run --files` on the four changed files: all hooks passed.

## Details

Qwen3 tokenizes `🍰이 맛있다` into tokens that decode individually as `['�', '��이', ' �', '�', '�', '�다']`: `��이` holds the last bytes of 🍰 followed by 이. `_verify_tokens` only corrected tokens whose decoded text ends with U+FFFD, so `��이` and `�다` were returned as is. In `_correct_decoded_token`, the context search stopped at the first context whose decoded text no longer ended with U+FFFD, which can still contain an incomplete character earlier in the string. Both checks now look for U+FFFD anywhere in the text. The rest of the correction, including the four-token context limit, is unchanged.

`OnlineDerenderer` (`vllm/renderers/online_derenderer.py`) has its own copy of `_correct_decoded_token` and the same trailing-only checks in `_resolve_logprobs`, so the second commit makes the same change there.

A literal U+FFFD in the text is dropped from the logprob tokens both before and after this change, since it can't be told apart from an incomplete byte sequence this way.

Duplicate check: I searched open and closed PRs and issues for `LogprobsProcessor`, `_correct_decoded_token`, `decoded_token`, the file path, and "logprobs" with "utf-8", "unicode", "replacement character" and "emoji". The earlier UTF-8 fixes for #27300 (#28874, #34875) are merged and this case fails with them. Open PRs that touch `vllm/v1/engine/logprobs.py` or its tests (#60542, #60915, #60918, #57442, #35961) change logprob storage, rendering and fast paths, not this correction. #60437 changes the parsed streaming path in `online_derenderer.py`, but not `_correct_decoded_token` or the checks in `_resolve_logprobs`.

I used AI assistance (Claude) to find, fix and test this bug and to write this description.

     assert resolved.content[1].bytes == list("é".encode())
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("chunk_size", [1, 100])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("split_prefix", [False, True])
+def test_utf8_continuation_before_valid_suffix(chunk_size, split_prefix):
+    tokenizer = get_tokenizer("Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B")
+    token_ids = tokenizer.encode("🍰이 맛있다", add_special_tokens=False)
+    if split_prefix:
+        token_ids[:1] = [tokenizer.get_vocab()[c] for c in ("ð", "Ł")]
+    entries = []
+    for start in range(0, len(token_ids), chunk_size):
+        logprobs = GenerateLogProbs(
+            content=[
+                GenerateLogProbsContent(
+                    token_id=token_id,
+                    logprob=-0.5,
+                    top_logprobs=[GenerateLogProb(token_id=token_id, logprob=-0.5)],
+                )
+                for token_id in token_ids[start : start + chunk_size]
+            ]
+        )
+        resolved = _resolve_logprobs(
+            logprobs,
+            tokenizer,
+            initial_context_token_ids=token_ids[max(0, start - 4) : start],
+        )
+        entries.extend(resolved.content)
+
+    expected = tokenizer.decode(token_ids)
+    for decoded in (entries, [entry.top_logprobs[0] for entry in entries]):
+        assert "".join(entry.token for entry in decoded) == expected
+        assert bytes(b for entry in decoded for b in entry.bytes) == expected.encode()
+
+

+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("flat_logprobs", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("split_prefix", [False, True])
+def test_utf8_continuation_before_valid_suffix(flat_logprobs, split_prefix):
+    """A token can finish an emoji or Hangul character and contain more text."""
+    tokenizer = get_tokenizer("Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B")

+        )
